versions.changelog: Align SKILL.md metadata with published version and lifecycle notes.
Sync local skill updates from workspace.
Added metadata with network disclosure (Notion API only)

Initial release: two-way Markdown ↔ Notion sync for blog/content workflows.

- Push local `.md` files to Notion or pull edited versions back
- Manage a Notion-based content pipeline database with customizable statuses (Seed → Published)
- Batch operations: push-all, per-file push/pull, and database creation scripts
- Automated round-trip content advance (pull, humanize, fact-check, push, update status)
- Sync local files and Notion pages using a configurable mapping
- Includes CLI commands, environment variable configuration, and schema documentation
